overview.about: The Riviera Maya Open is played at the El Camaleon course at Mayakoba on Mexico's Caribbean coast, a Greg Norman design threading through jungle, mangroves and limestone canals. The exotic setting makes it one of the most striking stops on the LPGA.
overview.nextEvent: The next Riviera Maya Open is played at El Camaleon in Playa del Carmen. Sea breezes and the course's jungle-and-canal setting create a beautiful but tricky test.
